name: usagebar
description: Your Claude plan usage (5-hour and weekly limits), context fill and session cost, in the status line and as pills above the prompt.

style.title: Style
style.description: compact (percentages) or full (+ reset times and cost)

warnAt.title: Warn at (%)
warnAt.description: Pills turn yellow from this percentage

alertAt.title: Alert at (%)
alertAt.description: Pills turn red and a toast shows once from this percentage

showContext.title: Show context
showContext.description: Also show how full the context window is

showCost.title: Show cost
showCost.description: Also show the session's cost in dollars

desktopPlacement.title: Desktop placement
desktopPlacement.description: Where the desktop app shows usage: pill (above the prompt), footer (status line beside the model) or both

showTokens.title: Show tokens
showTokens.description: Also show the tokens this session sent and received

pillStyle.title: Pill style
pillStyle.description: How the desktop pills look: soft (pastel), outline, solid or dark
